title: Lighthouse org guardrails: five SCPs and one RCP
scenario: Harbor Point Mutual's new AWS organization for the Lighthouse agent platform has OUs and accounts but no guardrails. Security signed off region, audit, IAM-user, Bedrock model and private-access rules plus an org-boundary RCP. Write them as code and prove them against a request table with a local SCP/RCP evaluator before anything is attached for real.
task: Region deny with a global-services exception and the US cross-Region inference exception
Protect the org trail and its bucket; deny leaving the org and creating IAM users or keys
Approved Bedrock models on Workloads and Sandbox; VPC-endpoint-only Bedrock and AgentCore in Prod
An RCP that blocks outside-org principals without breaking GitLab OIDC or AWS services
acceptance: Visible and hidden request tables give the expected decisions
Deny-only statements with Sids, FullAWSAccess kept, size limits, RCP shape
ANSWER.md has a no-lockout rollout plan and the limits of SCPs

practices.label: Week 1 Mon - Organizations and OU design
Week 1 Tue - SCPs, RCPs and policy evaluation
Week 1 Wed - agent guardrails: regions, models, endpoints
